new_libraries.name: Insight
new_libraries.author: zalhashfi
new_libraries.sentence: Connect ESP32/ESP8266 hardware to INSIGHT with a few lines of code.
new_libraries.paragraph: Hides WiFi, TLS, the WebSocket/HTTP transport, JSON and the control/telemetry protocol behind a tiny API. Handle cloud commands with INSIGHT_WRITE("var"){...} and push telemetry with Insight.send(). Works over an always-on WebSocket or HTTP polling for deep-sleep devices.
